title: Ulyana and the Tide
author: Mirabel Okafor
blurb: Beatrix Underhill, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent seven years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
